purpose: A small, human-selected set for checking whether conspicuous loose/disconnected conductors are surfaced by the review pipeline. It is intentionally separate from threshold calibration and field-accuracy measurement.

selection_protocol.review_method: Direct visual comparison of the original reference and raw inspection images; no candidate boxes, heatmaps, DINO scores, or registered images were used when choosing.
selection_protocol.include: Similar cabinet viewpoint plus at least one unambiguous, visually conspicuous loose or exposed conductor.
selection_protocol.exclude: Images with drawn title overlays, and cases where a local primary feature cannot be named without relying on generated-image-wide changes.

selected.primary_visible_group: Upper-middle white conductor visibly drops from the upper terminal area and ends free at the top rail.
selected.why_selected: Cabinet viewpoint remains close to the reference and the free conductor is visually isolated.

selected.primary_visible_group: A conspicuous white conductor terminates free in the central lower half of the cabinet.
selected.why_selected: The feature is large and visibly separated from the normal bundled wiring.

selected.primary_visible_group: A white conductor with a red-tipped free end hangs down through the upper-middle rail area.
selected.why_selected: The free end is explicit and the framing remains similar enough for qualitative replay.

selected.primary_visible_group: Two long white conductors hang freely across the upper-middle and lower-middle cabinet areas.
selected.why_selected: A deliberately harder multi-conductor case: the anomaly is still visually unmistakable while the cabinet layout stays close.

not_selected_for_this_set.reason: Clear loose-wire visuals exist, but AI changes to labels and wire detail are broader; reserve for later qualitative stress tests.
Some images carry black title overlays and the rest have stronger global re-rendering; reserve for later qualitative stress tests, not this first replay.

limits: The images are AI-generated variations and can contain multiple changes and global rendering variation.
No hit/miss rate, false-positive rate, or threshold conclusion may be calculated from this file.
Before automated replay, manually draw a named primary-group box for each selected image on raw side-by-side views.
